title: Encyclopaedia Britannica - Sixth edition, Volume 1, A-AME - EB.11
text: ALHESFORD, a town of Hampshire, tested on the road from London to Southampton, close by the river Itching, which feeds a good pond to the left of the towns. Part of a Roman highway runs from hence to Alton. It has one church, but two principal streets, which are large and break it and has a small manufacture of these. It is y a nice descent from London, and contained 1429 inhabitants in 1811.
